name: So can I use my app

messages.content: So can I use my app to watch adult videos? If so can we add a button that can be toggled to ask if your 18 and want that content or not?

**Yes, you can!** And I have just added a **1-tap `🔞 18+ Off / On` toggle button** with an **18+ Age Verification prompt** right at the top of your app and saved your changes.

### How the 18+ Toggle & Age Verification Works
1. **Top Header Toggle Button (`🔞 18+ Off` / `🔞 18+ On`):**
   - Look in the top-right corner of the app header in [index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L33-L46) (next to the `📲` install icon).
   - When it says **`🔞 18+ Off`**, tapping it opens the **18+ Adult Content Verification** prompt ([`openAgeGateModal`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L881-L884)) asking if you are **18 years of age or older** and want to enable 18+ adult video content.
   - Tapping **"✅ Yes, I'm 18+ — Enable Adult Content"** ([`setAdultContentEnabled`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L892-L902)) switches the button to a highlighted **`🔞 18+ On`** state and unlocks 18+ results across the app.
   - Tapping **`🔞 18+ On`** again at any time immediately turns 18+ content **Off** (back to Safe Mode) with a single tap.
2. **Synced with Settings:**
   - The **18+ Adult Content Filter** switch in the **Sources** tab ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L380-L390)) stays in sync with the top header button ([`syncAgeGateUI`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L867-L879)) and also asks for 18+ confirmation before turning on.

### How to Watch & Pull Adult Videos When `🔞 18+ On` Is Active
* **Quick Search & Multi-Engine Search:** Searching keywords on the **Player** or **Search Web** tab will now include 18+ video results from **Reddit** (`include_over_18=1`), **Internet Archive** (adult collections unlocked), **PeerTube (SepiaSearch)** (`nsfw=both`), **Mastodon**, and **Lemmy**.
* **Custom Subreddits & Topics:** In the **Sources** tab, you can add any 18+ subreddit or keyword topic so **Shuffle Random** and **Fullscreen Swipe (Reels) Mode** pull directly from them.
* **Webpage Video Scanner & Safari Bookmarklet:** You can also paste direct video links or use the **"Send to ReelVault"** Safari bookmarklet on webpages with downloadable video streams (`.mp4`, `.webm`, `.mov`, `.m3u8`, `.gifv`, etc.).
Don’t certain video websites that use like .m3u8 content put the content in little snippets so it makes it hard to capture? How did you get around that?

You are spot-on. A **`.m3u8` file** (HTTP Live Streaming, or **HLS**) isn’t actually a video file—it is a plain-text **playlist/manifest** that chops a video into dozens of 2-to-6-second snippet files (usually `.ts` MPEG-Transport Stream chunks or `.m4s` fragmented MP4 chunks). If you just download the `.m3u8` URL itself, you only get a tiny text file that iPhone Photos can't save.

Here is the **4-step pipeline** ReelVault uses in [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js) to get around `.m3u8` snippet splitting:

---

### 1. Direct `.MP4` Sibling Bypass (Fastest Path)
Many platforms (like Reddit, PeerTube, Internet Archive, and NASA) stream via `.m3u8` to their web player, but still store a single unsplit `.mp4` file in their API metadata alongside it.
* In [`extractRedditVideosFromListing`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1116-L1169) and [`searchPeerTubeVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1193-L1257), ReelVault checks for the direct `fallback_url` or `.mp4` derivative **first** and pairs it as `convertedUrl` so it can grab the whole `.mp4` in one shot without touching the snippets.

### 2. `.M3U8` Master & Media Playlist Crawler ([`parseM3u8Manifest`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L563-L635))
When a webpage or stream **only** has a `.m3u8` link:
* ReelVault reads the `.m3u8` text manifest first.
* **Master Playlist Resolution:** Many sites use a "Master" `.m3u8` that points to other `.m3u8` playlists for different resolutions (`360p`, `720p`, `1080p`) via `#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=...`. [`parseM3u8Manifest`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L563-L635) automatically picks the best mobile HD variant playlist and follows it.
* **Snippet & Header Extraction:** It extracts every relative or absolute snippet URL (`.ts`, `.m4s`, `.mp4`) in order, plus any `#EXT-X-MAP:URI="..."` initialization header used by fragmented MP4 streams.

### 3. Batch Snippet Downloading & Binary Stitching ([`downloadAndAssembleM3u8Stream`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L638-L694))
* Instead of downloading snippets one by one slowly, [`downloadAndAssembleM3u8Stream`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L638-L694) pulls the snippets in parallel batches of 4 (showing live progress like `Stitching .M3U8 snippet 12 of 35...`).
* Because MPEG-TS (`.ts`) and fMP4 (`init.mp4` + `.m4s`) segments are designed to be byte-concatenatable, ReelVault joins all their binary `Uint8Array` buffers in exact sequence into a single continuous video `Blob` in memory.

### 4. Lossless Container Remuxing to `.MP4` ([`transcodeBlobWithFfmpegWasm`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L334-L404) & [`transcodeBlobWithMediaRecorder`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L407-L510))
* Once the `.ts` snippets are stitched together, iPhone's Photos app still won't accept a `.ts` container directly.
* ReelVault passes the stitched stream into **FFmpeg.wasm** using `-c copy -movflags +faststart` ([app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L355-L374)), which **re-wraps (remuxes)** the already-encoded H.264/AAC video from `.ts` into an iPhone-native `.mp4` container in seconds without losing quality (with a fallback to iOS Safari's hardware `MediaRecorder` if needed).

> **Note on DRM-Encrypted Sites:** This works on standard open `.m3u8` streams (`EXT-X-KEY:NONE`). If a paid/subscription streaming service uses hardware DRM encryption (like Apple FairPlay or Widevine) or single-use signed session cookies locked to their domain, the browser's security sandbox will block third-party web apps from decrypting those segments.
